info.title: methods
info.description: Manual normal method maintenance, not independent self-evolution. Scope adoption requires current authority and an explicit synthetic-evidence limitation acknowledgment. Default .55/.25/.20; normalize finite weights; full authorized pool <=1000 before paging. Workspace > tenant > builtin; tie by time descending then UUID ascending. No task replay on stop/rollback. Published comparisons require current immutable standard and samples; business quality remains unvalidated.
